title: Build system: Makefile for NASM + C libraries
acceptance_criteria: Makefile compiles NASM assembly files (.asm) to object files (.o)
Makefile supports x86_64 architecture with ELF64 output format
Makefile defines build targets: all, clean, test, size-check
Makefile sets optimization flags for minimal binary size (-Os equivalent)
Makefile defines output binary name as 'fm' or 'file-manager'
Running 'make' produces at least one object file without errors
deliverables: src/main.asm (minimal entry point for build verification)
